why_ai: Regulation sustains demand, but consent, request and mapping workflows are mechanical software AI-native rivals rebuild.
why_clarity: Workflows are codified and high-volume, but consent validity and data meaning stay legally contested.
why_digital: Privacy management software sold and delivered entirely online.

why_ai: Assembling, routing and reviewing templated impact assessments is mechanical document work for AI.
why_clarity: Each assessment type has a defined structure, trigger and regulatory audience.
why_digital: Assessment documents drafted and routed entirely in software.

why_ai: Configurable banners and consent records are commodity software at internet scale.
why_clarity: Acceptance is measured instantly, but whether consent is valid is a regulator's later call.
why_digital: Consent banners served and recorded on websites.

why_ai: Scanning systems for where personal data lives replaces questionnaire-based mapping.
why_clarity: Data locations are checkable, though meaning and completeness are harder to verify.
why_digital: System scans and data maps produced entirely on screen.

why_ai: Every flow leaves a record, so instrumentation answers it without human judgment.
why_clarity: Observed flows are measurable systems facts, testable by instrumentation.
why_digital: Logs and network records analysed entirely in software.

why_ai: Lawful basis and purpose remain a lawyer's judgment about meaning, not a measurement.
why_clarity: Identification is mechanical, but basis and purpose calls are interpretive and contested.
why_digital: Data stores classified on screen by tools and counsel.

why_ai: Recipients of outbound data are observable, so the register can be derived automatically.
why_clarity: Each recipient either appears in observed traffic and contracts or does not.
why_digital: Vendor lists and outbound data records maintained digitally.

why_ai: Request orchestration is automated; only systems that resist deletion slow software down.
why_clarity: Each request has a statutory deadline and a verifiable deletion or export result.
why_digital: Requests received, routed and fulfilled entirely online.

why_ai: Scanning, categorising and gating site tags is mechanical work with mature tooling.
why_clarity: Each tag is either approved and gated or it is not.
why_digital: Website scripts scanned and controlled in software.

why_ai: Deleting from resistant warehouses and backups is system design work AI coding agents increasingly handle.
why_clarity: Deletion is verifiable, but each system needs a different approach.
why_digital: Scripts and data systems worked on entirely in code.

why_ai: The DPO is personally named to regulators and signs the processing record.
why_clarity: Accuracy of the signed record cannot be verified until a regulator tests it.
why_digital: Registers and evidence reviewed on screen, with regulator-facing accountability.
